REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY No. S. B. D. / Station Date March 30, 1940.）
Subject. Communication dated 18-3-40 from the British Consulate-General
concerning Mrs. L.M. Cherkassky and Mr. & Mrs D'Almeida.
Made by J.J. Prokofiev. Forwarded by Supt. J. Mason.

Mrs Lubov ( Lina ) Naumovna CHERKASSKY nee Hait,
Russian of Jewish origin, was born on 27-4-1904 at Harbin.
Her mother, Mrs M.M. Hait, is an old resident of Shanghai
and at present conducts a boarding house at 533/13 Ave-
nue Joffre ( Linda Terrace ).
She is the wife of Haim Mordkovich CHERKASSKY,
44, also a Russian of Jewish extraction. He arrived in
Shanghai from Harbin some time in 1923. Here he was em-
ployed with the Carlton Theatre as a mechanic for several
years, after which he conducted his own business in Ave-
nue Joffre known as the Parisian Shoe Store for a period.
From 1933 he has been connected with the China Finance
Corporation, 9 Avenue Edward VII and is at present employ-
ed as manager of the Frisco Bar, 39 Avenue Edward VII, ow-
ned by the China Finance Corporation.
In June, 1939 he applied for a visa to enable him
and his wife to proceed to France where they intended to
spend Mr. Cherkassky's three months' leave. He stated that
the passage etc. would be provided by his employers. En-
quiries made by the French Police indicated that he had
a capital of about C.N.$ 25,000. However, Mr. Cherkassky's
general reputation was not all that could be desired. It
would also appear that there existed certain doubts as to
the bona fides of the proposed trip to France. The appli-
cation for the visa in question was not granted. Shortly
afterwards the couple proceeded to Tsingtao on a holiday
trip, returning to Shanghai some time during the autumn of
the same year.

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特务科登记处 编号 S. B. D. / 分局 日期 1940年3月30日。）
事由：英国总领事馆1940年3月18日来函，涉及 L.M. 切尔卡斯基夫人及达尔梅达夫妇。
撰写人：J.J. 普罗科菲耶夫。呈报人：警司 J. 梅森。

柳博芙（莉娜）·瑙莫夫娜·切尔卡斯基（Lubov (Lina) Naumovna CHERKASSKY），娘家姓海特（Hait），俄籍犹太人，1904年4月27日出生于哈尔滨。其母 M.M. 海特夫人是上海的老居民，目前在霞飞路533号之13（林达台 Linda Terrace）经营一家寄宿公寓。

她是海姆·莫尔德科维奇·切尔卡斯基（Haim Mordkovich CHERKASSKY）的妻子。海姆现年44岁，也是俄籍犹太人。他于1923年某时从哈尔滨抵达上海。在此地，他曾在卡尔登大戏院（Carlton Theatre）担任机械师数年，随后在霞飞路经营一家名为“巴黎鞋店”（Parisian Shoe Store）的店铺一段时间。自1933年起，他与爱多亚路9号的中国金融公司（China Finance Corporation）有业务往来，目前受雇于该公司旗下的爱多亚路39号弗里斯科酒吧（Frisco Bar），担任经理。

1939年6月，他申请签证，以便携妻子前往法国，计划在那里度过切尔卡斯基先生为期三个月的假期。他声称旅费等将由雇主提供。经法国警方调查，显示他拥有约国币25,000元的资本。然而，切尔卡斯基先生的总体声誉并不尽如人意。此外，似乎对其拟议的法国之行的真实性存在某些疑虑。该签证申请未获批准。不久后，夫妇二人前往青岛度假，并于同年秋季某时返回上海。

On 28-6-34 and on 7-7-36 warrants of arrest were
issued against Mr. Cherkassky by the 2nd U.S.S.R. Court in
connection with some civil cases.

There is nothing in the Municipal Police records
concerning Mrs Cherkassky ,and enquiries have failed to
elicit any information detrimental to her character.

Discreet enquiries from members of the local Por-
tuguese community show that Mr. C.M. D'Almeida, age about
50, is known to have formerly worked in Shanghai as an
accountant, after which he is reported to have been re-
siding for various periods in other ports in the Far
East. His last known visit in Shanghai was in 1939 when
he arrived here from Hongkong on 27-6-39 aboard the s.s.
"Conte Biancamano" together with his wife ( Mrs Cherkas-
sky's sister ). The couple stayed at the Metropole Hotel.
On 3-10-39 Mrs D'Almeida was about to leave Shanghai for
Hongkong in the s.s. "Asama Maru", but was obliged to post-
pone her departure owing to the fact that customs officers
discovered in her luggage certain undeclared property
( furs and jewellery ) valued, it is reported, at ¥50,000.
She proved that the jewellery was her own ,and was fined
¥1,500 plus export duty for failing to declare the furs.
There was no court case in this connection and on Octo-
ber 17 of the same year she left for Hongkong aboard the
s.s. "Hakusen Maru".

1934年6月28日和1936年7月7日，苏联第二法院因一些民事案件对切尔卡斯基先生发出了逮捕令。

工部局警务处档案中没有任何关于切尔卡斯基夫人的记录，且调查未能发现任何损害其品行的信息。

向当地葡萄牙社区成员进行的谨慎调查显示，C.M. 达尔梅达先生，年龄约50岁，据知以前在上海担任会计师，此后据报道在远东其他港口断续居住。他最近一次已知到访上海是在1939年，当时他于1939年6月27日与其妻子（切尔卡斯基夫人的妹妹）乘坐“比安卡马诺伯爵号”（s.s. "Conte Biancamano"）轮船从香港抵达此处。夫妇二人入住大都会酒店（Metropole Hotel）。1939年10月3日，达尔梅达夫人原计划乘坐“浅间丸”（s.s. "Asama Maru"）离开上海前往香港，但因海关官员在其行李中发现某些未申报的财产（皮草和珠宝），据报价值50,000日元，被迫推迟行程。她证明珠宝为其自有物品，并因未申报皮草被罚款1,500日元及出口税。此事未引发诉讼，同年10月17日，她乘坐“白泉丸”（s.s. "Hakusen Maru"）前往香港。

CHINA PRESS, October 4, 1940.

Customs Seize
Lakh Worth Of
Jewelry, Fur

Jewelry and 50 pieces of fur, valued at $100,000, were taken from aboard the s.s. Asama Maru yesterday when preventive officers of the Shanghai Maritime Customs visited the ship shortly before she was scheduled to sail for Hongkong.

The property, which belonged to a Portuguese lady, Mrs. C. E. d'Almeida, was detained because they had not been "declared" in accordance with customs regulations.

In order to complete their search, the Customs officers had to request the captain to delay the sailing of of the liner by 15 minutes.

Taken unawares, Mrs d'Almeida was informed by the visiting officers in her cabin that they would like to see her baggage. A search was subsequently made and her valuables were later removed to the Customs shed at the Way-side Wharf where the ship had just weighed anchor.

《字林西报》，1940年10月4日。

海关查获
价值十万之
珠宝、皮草

昨日，在上海海关预防科官员登上即将启航前往香港的“浅间丸”轮船前不久，从船上查扣了价值10万美元的珠宝和50件皮草。

这批财产属于一位葡萄牙女士 C. E. 达尔梅达夫人，因其未按海关规定进行“申报”而被扣留。

为了完成搜查，海关官员不得不请求船长将班轮的开航时间推迟15分钟。

达尔梅达夫人在舱内猝不及防，来访官员告知她想查看她的行李。随后进行了搜查，她的贵重物品后来被移至刚刚起锚的轮船所在的旁侧码头（Way-side Wharf）海关棚屋。

Railway. It appears that she is of a modest origin and
education. According to her own statement, prior to her
coming to Shanghai she worked at Harbin as a dressmaker
for a period. She arrived in Shanghai in July, 1937 and
soon afterwards started to work as a dancing partner in
local cabarets. From 15.1.38 to 24.5.38 she resided in
a small Russian boarding house at 606 Avenue Joffre,
House 7, during which period she is reported to have been
cohabiting with a Russian named J. Maknan, a mechanic by
occupation. During the summer of 1938 she was absent to
Tsingtao and following her return to Shanghai is known
to have resided at 348 Rue Bourgeat, also a Russian board-
ing house of a modest type, from 4.12.38 to 11.6.39. Her
next known address is 382 Rue Krelupt, Apt. 1.

季娜伊达·瓦西里耶夫娜·列瓦德尼（Zinaida vassilievna LEVADNY）小姐，俄国人，1918年4月1日出生于中东铁路皮套河子站（Pitaochedzy Station）。她似乎出身和教育程度一般。据其自称，在来上海之前，她曾在哈尔滨做过一段时间的裁缝。她于1937年7月抵达上海，不久后开始在当地歌舞厅担任舞伴。1938年1月15日至1938年5月24日期间，她居住在霞飞路606号7室的一家小型俄国人寄宿公寓，在此期间，据报道她与一名名叫 J. 马克南（J. Maknan）的俄国人同居，后者职业为机械师。1938年夏季，她前往青岛，返回上海后，已知从1938年12月4日至1939年6月11日居住在布尔热路348号，这也是一家档次一般的俄国人寄宿公寓。她下一个已知住址是克雷吕普路382号1室。

1939年12月初，在申请护照以便前往哈尔滨、青岛和日本时，列瓦德尼小姐毫不隐瞒她与一名美国人同居的事实，但未透露该男子的姓名。另有报告称，几天前在与一位女性朋友交谈时，她提到了前情人在马尼拉去世的事。对此需要指出的是，1940年3月19日，当地报纸刊登了一则发自马尼拉、日期为3月18日的电报，内容涉及美国海军“马布尔黑德号”（U.S.S. Marblehead）水手约翰·伦道夫·弗尔希尔（John Randolph Firshir）涉嫌被谋杀一事。因此，

NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS, MARCH 19, 1940.

Marblehead Murder
Mystery Solved
Four Men Arrested; One Said
Confessed to Killing Seaman
Manila, Mar. 18.
The mysterious disappearance of
Seaman John Randolph Pirschar, of
Birmingham, Alabama, aboard the
U.S.S. Marblehead, on February 21,
was solved yesterday with the arrest
of four men, one of whom was al-
leged to have confessed to the
murder of the sailor, the "Manila
Bulletin" reported from Olongapo
today.
The seaman was robbed, murdered
and his body was throwned into the
sea, according to the confession, the
"Bulletin" said.—United Press.

马尼拉，3月18日。

April 1, 1940.
Morning Translation.

Shun Pao and Sin Wan Pao of March 31 :-

CHINESE COMPLAINT AGAINST Y.M.C.A. PERFORMANCE

On the night of March 29, a stage performance entitled "Chinese Vendors" was given by the Carnival and Circus sponsored by the Foreign Y.M.C.A., in which the behaviour of low class Chinese was depicted. The play was highly insulting to Chinese people. When the hisses from the Chinese members of the audience went unheeded by the players and sponsors, some of the Chinese audience rose and left the performance.

Mr. Bright, Chief of the Athletics Section of the Foreign Y.M.C.A., has always been on good terms with Chinese athletes, but he is absent from Shanghai and his post is at present being held by Schaberg. It is indeed regrettable that such an insulting performance to the Chinese should have been staged in the Foreign Y.M.C.A., especially at a time when Mr. Bright is away from Shanghai. It is sincerely hoped that sporting and newspaper circles will do something to urge the authorities of the Foreign Y.M.C.A. to take action and to give an assurance that a recurrence will not take place. If this request be ignored, sporting circles, with a view to upholding our national prestige, should withdraw from participation in all sports contests sponsored by the Association as a sign of non-cooperation.

1940年4月1日。
晨间译文。

3月31日的《申报》和《新闻报》：-

华人对青年会演出之抗议

3月29日晚，由西侨青年会主办的嘉年华和马戏团上演了一出名为《中国小贩》的舞台剧，剧中描绘了底层华人的行为。该剧对华人群体极具侮辱性。当华人观众发出嘘声而未受演员及主办方理睬时，部分华人观众起身退场。

西侨青年会体育部主任布莱特（Bright）先生一向与华人运动员关系良好，但他目前不在上海，其职务现由沙伯格（Schaberg）代理。在西侨青年会上演如此侮辱华人的剧目，尤其是在布莱特先生离沪期间，实令人遗憾。诚望体育界和新闻界采取行动，敦促西侨青年会当局对此事进行处理，并保证不再发生类似事件。若此要求被忽视，体育界为维护国家尊严，应退出参与该会主办的一切体育比赛，以示不合作。
